steps.text:
Navigate to the “CliQ Tab” Section: 
 -  Log in to the mobile application. 
 - From the account dashboard, navigate to the ' CliQ ' section and click on it.

A new action button will appear:
  - CliQ Transfer (existing) 
 -  Manage my CliQ (existing) 
 - CliQ Transactions History (NEW)

When the user taps CliQ Transactions History, two tabs will appear: 
 - Inward 
 - Outward
Under each Inward CliQ payment (Local or International), a Return Payment button appears only if the transaction is within the allowed period (7 days from recipient)

When a user clicks on the return button for eligible transaction to return it, the pop-up page appears with: 
 - Transaction details: Description, Date, Amount, Status  
 - And the Reason dropdown list for customer to select from: ( ▪ Unrecognized payment from a stranger , ▪ Unrecognized payment from a known contact , ▪ Wrong Amount )
For Cross Border (International CliQ transactions) only full amount return is allowed.
For Local CliQ transactions, Partial or full return is allowed and the partial for one time only
Once the return reason is selected customer can confirm to proceed “Return Payment” or cancel, noting the Return is subject to OTP authentication.
Once transaction is returned, it becomes ineligible for further returns and the button disappears

title: Steps to Return Local or International CliQ Transactions
